summary: This clinical trial is studying ways to treat a condition called hepatic steatosis, which is a buildup of fat in the liver linked to obesity. Researchers want to test different approaches using a special diet and a medication called semaglutide. A total of 120 participants will be placed into one of three groups to receive nutrition support, the medication, or both. The study has a status of Not yet recruiting and is sponsored by Institut universitaire de cardiologie et de pneumologie de Québec, University Laval.
